A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Investigate parcel-index on 2026-05-02, comparing reference 10:00–11:00 with incident 11:00–12:00. arguments.command:
cd /data; cat > /work/metrics.sql <<'EOF'
with ops as (
  select o.operation_id, o.route_id, o.opened_at_ms, case when o.opened_at_ms>=1777716000000 and o.opened_at_ms<1777719600000 then 'reference_10_11' when o.opened_at_ms>=1777719600000 and o.opened_at_ms<1777723200000 then 'incident_11_12' end period
  from logical_operations o join service_routes r using(route_id) where r.service_id=(select service_id from services where service_code='parcel-index') and o.opened_at_ms>=1777716000000 and o.opened_at_ms<1777723200000),
asg as (select ops.*, ra.pool_id, ra.profile_id, ra.release_id, ra.assignment_id from ops join route_assignments ra on ra.route_id=ops.route_id and ops.opened_at_ms>=ra.effective_from_ms and ops.opened_at_ms<ra.effective_to_ms),
att as (select a.operation_id, count(*) n, sum(f.is_success=0) failed from attempt_events a join failure_codes f using(code_id) group by a.operation_id),
lst as (select a.operation_id, f.is_success last_ok from attempt_events a join failure_codes f using(code_id) where a.attempt_no=(select max(b.attempt_no) from attempt_events b where b.operation_id=a.operation_id))
select asg.period, p.pool_code, count(*) operations, sum(lst.last_ok=0) terminal_failures, round(100.0*sum(lst.last_ok=0)/count(*),4) terminal_pct,
 sum(att.n) attempts, sum(att.failed) failed_attempts, round(100.0*sum(att.failed)/sum(att.n),4) attempt_pct, sum(att.n>1) retried, min(d.deadline_ms) min_deadline, max(d.deadline_ms) max_deadline
from asg join worker_pools p using(pool_id) join policy_profiles d on d.profile_id=asg.profile_id join att using(operation_id) join lst using(operation_id)
where asg.period is not null group by asg.period, p.pool_code order by 1,2;
EOF
sqlite3 -header current.db < /work/metrics.sql
